Requirement: Email and password are mandatory for login.
Registration requires a valid and unique email.
Password must contain at least 8 characters.
Only authenticated employees can access their timesheets.
Employees can select only projects assigned to them.
Project selection and working date are mandatory.
Working hours must be an integer between 1 and 12 inclusive.
Invalid timesheet submissions must not create database records.
One intentional submission must create exactly one record. Rapid double-clicking must not create unintended duplicates.
Automation: test_calculation_and_single_record; test_retry_is_idempotent; test_concurrent_retry; test_separate_intentions_allowed; browser: test_rapid_double_click

Requirement: Billable amount = working hours × project hourly rate.
Employees must only view their own timesheet records.
Valid records must persist after a page refresh.
